reuse.why: Builds on the existing recurConfigToRSchedule and getDateWithSkippedWeekend, adds one shared recurConfigToExcludedRules for the daily-skip and holiday exclusions, and reuses monthUtils/dayFromDate, rather than re-implementing date logic per site.

duplication.why: The RSchedule({rrules, exrules}) construction is now spelled out in rule-utils, getUpcomingDates and getDatesInRange, and getDatesInRange repeats getUpcomingDates' occurrences -> skipWeekend ? getDateWithSkippedWeekend(...) : date pipeline instead of sharing it.

placement.why: Date rules live in shared/schedules.ts, the handler in server/schedules/app.ts next to schedule/get-upcoming-dates, and the config type in types/models/schedule.ts.

scope.why: Changes are confined to the four requested behaviours, their tests and release notes.

maintainability.why: The core rules are centralised, but every caller still has to remember to add exrules and to thread holidays through its own skipWeekend ternary, and getDateWithSkippedWeekend gained a convoluted invalid-mode branch.

abstraction_drift.where: getDateWithSkippedWeekend gained a holidays parameter (threaded by hand through getNextDate, getUpcomingDates, getDatesInRange and both schedule-template calls) and a special branch for unknown solve modes that checks holidays; getDatesInRange re-implements the occurrence/adjust pipeline of getUpcomingDates, and RSchedule+exrules construction is repeated at each site instead of one builder.
